# GPAbin

`GPAbin` biplots to unify visualisations from multiple imputed data.

## Installation

You can install the development version of GPAbin from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

devtools::install_github("jnienk/GPAbin")
```

## About the name

Generalised orthogonal Procrustes analysis (**GPA**) is used to align
individual biplots before combining their separate coordinate sets into
an average coordinate matrix, to mimic Ru**bin**’s rules. Finally, this
average coordinate matrix is then utilized to construct a single biplot
called a GPAbin biplot.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`CLPpred()`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/CLPpred.md) :
  Category level prediction
- [`DRT()`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/DRT.md) :
  Dimension reduction
- [`GPA()`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/GPA.md) :
  Generalised Orthogonal Procrustes Analysis
- [`GPAbin()`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/GPAbin.md) :
  Function to unify coordinates of multiple configurations
- [`OPA()`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/OPA.md) :
  Orthogonal Procrustes Analysis
- [`biplFig()`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/biplFig.md) :
  Biplot function
- [`compdat`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/compdat.md) :
  Complete data example
- [`evalMeas()`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/evalMeas.md)
  : Evaluation measures when complete data is available
- [`implist`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/implist.md) :
  List of multiple imputed data sets
- [`impute()`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/impute.md) :
  Multiple imputation
- [`missdat`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/missdat.md) :
  Missing data example
- [`missmi()`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/missmi.md) :
  First step before constructing unified biplots
- [`print(`*`<missmi>`*`)`](https://jnienk.github.io/GPAbin/reference/print.missmi.md)
  : Generic print function for objects of class missmi
